title: GET /status has no linked regression coverage
reasoning: The reviewed feature exposes authenticated client activity and auto-disable state, but the feature metadata lists no tests for this route. That leaves the response contract, API-key enforcement, nullable datetime serialization, and days_until_auto_disable behavior unpinned against regressions.
recommendation: Add route-level tests for authorized and unauthorized GET /status requests, asserting the response shape and key field values for representative client settings states.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this semantic feature.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use FastAPI TestClient to call GET /status with a valid API key after stubbing or seeding activity_tracker settings, assert HTTP 200 and all ClientStatusResponse fields; also assert missing/invalid API key is rejected.
minimumFixScope: Add focused tests for app/api/client.py GET /status without changing route behavior.
